title: The Overscore
calendarLocation: Berkeley Finnish Hall, 1970 Chestnut St, Berkeley, CA 94702
description:
An improvised ritual of movement, voice, and live music.

Saturday 2:30–5:30pm: World building and mapping the landscape. Facilitation by Marcus van Duren.
Sunday 2:30–5:30pm: The Overscore.

Live music by Ian Erickson.

title: Kinetic Waves
theme: Dancing is Walking, Feet and Spine
description:
Friday Morning Dance Class rooted in the study and application of The Axis Syllabus©

Facilitated by AS Teacher Candidate, Marcus van Duren

$20 drop in / Notaflof

A typical session includes zooming in on anatomy, bio-mechanics, movement motifs, improvisation, and grooving to music.
